home.title: hmyLaser32
home.subtitle: DIY Lasertag with ESP32 — Online bridge & Wiki
home.intro: hmyLaser32 is a DIY Lasertag system based on ESP32 microcontrollers. The game state is coordinated locally via ESP-NOW; this website is the optional online extension providing player profiles, statistics and build instructions.

features.wiki: DIY wiki with schematics and build guide
features.bridge: Online bridge to the ESP32 server for live data
features.profile: Player profiles with NFC tokens and match history
